state: This repository runs private TypeScript on a locked Bun 1.4.2 build and already has a clean strict TypeScript 7.0.2 check plus clean Oxlint 1.85.0 defaults. The new request is an online-informed Oxc formatter and agent-friendly lint policy. Trial installations are Oxfmt 0.70.0 and tsgolint 7.0.2002. Oxfmt flags 175 of 178 runtime/tooling files, while a generated 15,774-line catalogue and pinned vendor sources must stay untouched. Type-aware lint reports 53 items (31 await-thenable, 15 floating promises, 5 unbound methods, one base-to-string, one redundant union). Some tests intentionally exercise unusual values and the runtime manages promise ownership. A full formatting pass plus CI check, an unguarded write command, or a changed-file gate are available. Lint choices are a small type-aware correctness set, every category, or the current defaults. No external source compatibility is required, but semantic runtime contracts remain mandatory.

format.instructions: Select the rollout for Oxfmt across maintained TypeScript.

criteria.full: Apply Oxfmt to the full authored scope now and require its check command thereafter, with generated/vendored exclusions.
criteria.command_only: Provide formatting tooling for optional use and postpone any baseline or CI enforcement.
criteria.changed_only: Leave the old style in place and enforce Oxfmt just on files a change touches.

lint.instructions: Choose the useful next level of Oxlint rules for agent edits.

criteria.focused_type_aware: Use selected type-informed correctness checks and resolve true problems, documenting only site-specific intentional exceptions.
criteria.all_rules: Activate all categories and type-based rules simultaneously, accepting extensive style noise and broad cleanup.
criteria.defaults_only: Do not add type-aware diagnostics beyond the existing compiler check and default lint.
